title: Grateful Dead Live at Madison Square Garden on 1982-09-20
lineage: CD -> Samplitude Professional v9.12 -> Cool Edit Pro v.20 -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a high‑energy show, with a scorching Scarlet Fire and a nonstop groove from Shakedown.
ai_review.review: The performance is praised for its relentless drive from the opening minute of Shakedown through an energetic Day Job and a standout second‑set Scarlet Fire that blends precision and beauty. Reviewers also note the superb soundboard source, with clear audio and expertly patched cuts, making it a top‑tier listening experience.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviewers gave high marks (5 and 4 stars), highlighting an exceptional performance and excellent soundboard quality with minimal issues.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Very clear sbd recording; a few cuts were patched expertly, resulting in a clean, listenable mix.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong momentum from the first set onward; second‑set Scarlet Fire is highlighted as a rare moment of precision and beauty.

band_member_comments.Keys: Brent's keyboard work on Day Job is praised, noting his great playing and contribution to the fun vibe of the song.
